title: ChatGPT Outage: Global Disruption Impacts Thousands
description: Reports indicate a significant outage of ChatGPT, an AI chatbot by OpenAI, affecting thousands of users worldwide.

sections.heading: Outage Details
paragraphs: ChatGPT, a popular AI chatbot developed by OpenAI, has reportedly experienced a global outage, leaving thousands of users unable to access its services.
According to The Times of India, users worldwide are facing issues with the platform, which has resulted in widespread disruption.

sections.heading: User Impact
paragraphs: Digit reports that users are unable to get answers from the chatbot, indicating a massive outage affecting the service.

sections.heading: Resolution
paragraphs: The Independent notes that OpenAI has restored function after acknowledging the issues and working to resolve them.

faq.a: ChatGPT is an AI chatbot developed by OpenAI that allows users to interact with it in a conversational manner.
ChatGPT experienced a global outage, as reported by multiple sources, which prevented users from accessing its services.
Yes, according to The Independent, OpenAI has restored the function of ChatGPT after addressing the outage.
